fields.name: height_left
fields.label: Height left (raw)
fields.description: Left ride-height sensor (raw 0–255). Normal ~110–135; L≈R on level ground.

fields.name: any_door
fields.label: Door open
fields.description: Any door open. SLABS won't adjust suspension with a door open. Normal: closed.

fields.name: battery
fields.label: Battery
fields.description: System voltage. 13.8–14.4 V running; below 13 = charging fault.

fields.name: wheel_speed_rr

fields.description: Rear-right wheel speed. ⚠ Wheel order unconfirmed.
